newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat rises in Milan on car incentive hopes.
newsitem.headline: Fiat rises in Milan on car incentive hopes.

text.p: Fiat shares rose on the Milan stock exchange on comments by a government minister that end-year measures being studied by the cabinet might include some action to boost the depressed Italian car market.
Environment minister Edo Ronchi told reporters he thought the cabinet may approve measures to stimulate new car buying.
"At any other time Fiat shares would be flying but in such small end-year volume it is still performing very well," one trader said.
At 1450 GMT, Fiat shares were 2.89 percent up at 4,350 lire, after touching a high of 4,380 lire, in volume of just over three million shares.
The all-share Mibtel index posted a modest 0.8 percent rise.
